purpose: Observe boundary and bottom-soil state across the first two scheduled Shepard events and isolate CPU/GPU divergence; causal diagnosis only.
outputs: Exclusive tests/outputs/sw_shepard_event_r1_{cpu_on,gpu_on,cpu_off,gpu_off}; logs/manifests under tests/logs; CSV histories/comparisons under tests/figures
programs: Current private CPU/GPU executables and all four runtime dependencies adopted by hash from sw_stage1_short_r1.inputs.json; no rebuild and no bin replacement
reader: ReadSelfWeightNative.exe from sw_native_r1.build.json: 38 native fields, all IDs0..1039; appended is_boundary, porepress0, excess_native. Header mass is fluid mass for every row and is not per-ID boundary mass.
binding: Prior Stage1 inputs, nested symc inputs and frozen compiled-source snapshots, both frozen helpers, native-reader build inputs/program/log, GenCase, private solver builds/programs/runtime, XML/BAT, worker and this note are reverified before execution and after each job.

parameter_differences.PoreShepardRegularization: 1 for ON, 0 for OFF; OFF alone changes this physical switch
parameter_differences.all_other_physical_settings: Inherited unchanged from formal Stage1; HydraulicConductivity=0, so Darcy correction is bypassed

individual_safety: Each job is independently attempted and its exit/output hashes sealed; live solver or existing outputs are refused
All 1040 IDs, native finite values, no excluded particles, elastic state, positive density, double saved positions/stress, unchanged mass/dp/h
Original soil geometry screens: z>0, periodic x displacement<0.5mm, layer span<0.5mm
Exactly the original ten top soil IDs have FSType2/3 and their pressure is exactly zero
Natural step is0 for Part0 and otherwise saved_step+1; actual native time agrees within1e-12s. Saved cadence is observed rather than assumed
After Part0 preserve the original signed dterror_s<=1e-14 test; do not replace it with abs(dterror)
Native porepress0 remains exactly fixed and excess_native equals float32(pressure)-float32(porepress0)
comparisons: CPU/GPU ON and OFF separately at equal actual natural/saved step and native time within1e-12s; original soil pressure RMS<=5Pa and material displacement maximum difference<=0.005mm. All comparison rows and focus differences are retained before reporting rejection.
history: Every actual native frame; all40 boundary IDs plus bottom three soil layers (IDs40,41,42 +100*k, k0..9); all38 native fields include pressure/reference/excess/density/six stress components. Event brackets report nearest actual saved frames before and at/after natural steps40/80.
